text: Implemented owned/versioned registered-task submit and typed-result read dialects; target-side RegisteredTaskLauncher staging; preserved SubmissionAttempt including AcceptanceUnknown; bounded frame-aware result reads; durable descriptor codec; RemoteSlurm submit/submitOrRaise, attach, await, and awaitValue; agent worker configuration; fixtures and loopback parity/reconnect/rejection/OOM/timeout/oversize/stale-epoch tests.
